Use ONLY the cream tile, bright red horizontal band, blue cap/base, and dark outline palette shown in first reference. It is a Dark source plus accepted views contact. Ignore any other styles. Row2: FRONT/REAR are narrow tile-wall end faces; RIGHT/LEFT are broad cream-red-blue facades; TOP/BOTTOM are thin vertical blue strips along Y, not a full facade. Make the red stripe a single horizontal band at the same vertical location in every upright elevation. Source artwork is pixel art; use crisp square pixels, not glow/shading.
